title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size
tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

faults.what: The portrait variant's lettering looks vertically stretched or condensed compared with the more natural proportions in the square and landscape versions.

judge.summary: All three ads contain the correct, readable text and matching leafy green-and-cream styling, though the portrait typography looks slightly stretched.

must_haves.item: Three finished images have the requested 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.
must_haves.why: The supplied images are portrait 9:16, landscape 16:9, and square 1:1.

must_haves.item: All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.
must_haves.why: All five strings are spelled correctly and appear in full in each image.

must_haves.item: Every text line, including 'Visit 24 Willow Lane', is comfortably readable when each image is viewed at its delivered size without zooming.
must_haves.why: Every line is readily legible, including the address in the landscape version.

must_haves.item: Text has clear contrast against its background and is not obscured by leaves or other text.
must_haves.why: Dark green lettering sits on clear cream areas without overlapping foliage or other lines.

must_haves.item: No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.
must_haves.why: Nothing is clipped, but the portrait lettering has noticeably taller, narrower proportions than the other variants.

must_haves.item: The variants retain matching leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling while adjusting text placement or line breaks to suit each shape.
must_haves.why: The foliage, palette, typography, and hierarchy match, with spacing and placement adapted to the three canvases.
